newsitem.title: USA: TurboChef to supply ovens to Seven-Eleven.
newsitem.headline: TurboChef to supply ovens to Seven-Eleven.

text.p: TurboChef Inc said Tuesday Southland Corp placed a purchase order for an undisclosed number of ovens to be used in its Seven-Eleven stores.
The ovens, somewhat smaller than TurboChef's "restaurant" model, will be configured for use in convenience stores.

"While our technologies have proven successful in restaurants, where food quality is the primary factor, this agreement represents our first sale to a giant convenience store chain where speed of service is also critical," TurboChef said.
With some 15,700 stores worldwide, Seven-Eleven is the largest chain in the convenience retailing industry, the company said.
More than 5,400 Seven-Eleven and other convenience stores are operated or franchised in the United States and Canada by Southland, TurboChef said.
